title: Application of Eastern Edison Company under the provisions of G.L. c. 164, § 94G 1/2 and the Company's tariff, M.D.P.U. 131 for approval by the Department of Public Utilties of a change in the Company's Oil Conservation Adjustment charge to be billed to the Company's customers pursuant to meter readings taken in the billing months of June, July and August 1985. The Oil Conservation Adjustment surcharge recovers the cost of conversion from oil-fired to coal-fired generation and its calculation is based on the respective costs of burning coal and oil.
